subject: CareGrid MAP: integration build milestone owners, target close, and blockers
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lindsey Turner <lindsey.turner@caregrid.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthplex.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:12:00 -0400
Subject: CareGrid MAP: integration build milestone owners, target close, and blockers

Hi Lindsey / Samir —

Thanks again for the demo earlier — couple quick notes and a first pass at the MAP milestone for the integration build work (SDK + streaming + tool calling + structured outputs). I attached a draft spreadsheet (caregrid_map_draft_v1.xlsx) with milestones and owners. Please review and confirm or suggest changes.

High-level milestones (integration-focused):
- Integration Kickoff (shared design doc & network access) — target: 2026-08-12 — owner: CareGrid (Samir) + Redwood SE (Marissa)
- SDK Integration (client-side SDK, auth flow) — target: 2026-08-26 — owner: CareGrid devs (TBD) / Redwood SE to provide adapters
- Streaming + KV cache validation (long-lived sessions, reconnects) — target: 2026-09-02 — owner: Redwood engineering (Marissa + Neha)
- Tool-calling & structured outputs (tool contract, schema) — target: 2026-09-09 — owner: CareGrid product + Redwood engineering (Marissa)
- End-to-end validation & perf run (staging) — target: 2026-09-16 — owner: CareGrid QA + Redwood
- Go-live (production cutover) — target close: 2026-09-20 — owner: joint

Dependencies / blockers we flagged on the call:
1) VPC peering / network rules — need internal contact and network window for testing.
2) Production API keys & rate limits for staging — Redwood needs test keys and expected QPS.
3) Example payloads + desired output schema (for structured outputs) — if you can drop a sample dataset or spec that speeds up wiring.
4) Security questionnaire (you mentioned procurement) — Jordan can assist with redlines.

Ask: can you confirm owners for the SDK integration task (CareGrid dev lead), and whether the 2026-09-20 target close is realistic from your side? If you prefer, we can shift the timeline by one week.

Next steps I propose:
- Lindsey / Samir: confirm owners + any date changes by EOD Friday (2026-08-07).
- Marissa: follow up with an implementation checklist and code sample (will attach).
- Jordan: procurement / SOW and commercial alignment (cc'd).

Attachment: caregrid_map_draft_v1.xlsx (draft MAP, milestones tab)

Thanks —
Aditya
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123
From: Lindsey Turner <lindsey.turner@caregrid.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthplex.io>, integrations@caregrid.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CareGrid MAP: integration build milestone owners, target close, and blockers

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP file. Overall the milestones look reasonable. A couple notes from our side:
- We can own the SDK integration work but would like Redwood to deliver the adapter examples and an auth pattern (token refresh + example). I will confirm our dev lead (likely Priya Singh) by tomorrow.
- Procurement asked if we can push the go-live by one week to 2026-09-27 to allow final billing sign-off. Is that acceptable?
- Security questionnaire is in progress; we'll send the PDF by Monday and include the SharePoint link for SOC2 evidence.

I'll confirm owners and the procurement request by EOD Friday.

Cheers,
Lindsey Turner
Head of Product Integrations | CareGrid
lindsey.turner@caregrid.com
(617) 555-0901
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthplex.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Lindsey Turner <lindsey.turner@caregrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CareGrid MAP: integration build milestone owners, target close, and blockers

Aditya / Lindsey —

Quick technical follow-up from our eng team after reviewing the draft:
- We agree CareGrid will own the SDK integration on the client side. Our preference is for Redwood to supply a lightweight JS + Python adapter and a sample reconnect flow for streaming.
- For tool-calling, our product team wants the contract defined (inputs/outputs) up front. We will assign a product owner but will require Redwood to own the tool-call adapter in prod.
- For network access, please confirm the test IP ranges and whether Redwood supports a temporary public endpoint during the initial perf tests (we have strict peering windows).

Blockers we need resolved to hit the current schedule:
1) Network window: request a two-hour window 8/18 for staged perf tests.
2) Access to a schema repo or sample payloads for structured outputs.

I assigned internal owner names in our tracking doc (I'll share the link separately).

Thanks —
Samir Patel
Director, Integrations | HealthPlex (CareGrid partner)
samir.patel@healthplex.io
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthplex.io>, Lindsey Turner <lindsey.turner@caregrid.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CareGrid MAP: integration build milestone owners, target close, and blockers

Thanks — adding a few implementation details and clarifications from Redwood SE perspective:

1) Adapter deliverables (what we'll supply):
- JS & Python SDK adapters (auth + streaming reconnect pattern) — repo + example app.
- Tool-calling reference with OpenAPI contract and a sample lambda-style handler for structured outputs.
- Structured-output schemas: we'll provide a JSON Schema template and a mapping guide for your payloads.

2) Testing / perf:
- We can support a temporary public endpoint for initial perf runs if you cannot provision peering immediately. We'll need an IP allowlist for the test window.
- For KV/prefix caching behavior: we'll provide a recommended cache TTL and a small test harness to reproduce tokenization and latency characteristics.

3) Blockers we need from CareGrid:
- Staging credentials (test keys) and a sample PII-redacted payload set.
- Contact for networking (vpn/netops) and a preferred perf window (Samir suggested 8/18 — we can tentatively reserve 08/18 14:00-16:00 ET but need confirmation).

Attachment: sdk-integration-checklist.pdf (technical checklist + sample endpoints)

Quote: "On Thu, 6 Aug 2026 at 08:22, Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthplex.io> wrote:
> For network access, please confirm the test IP ranges and whether Redwood supports a temporary public endpoint during the initial perf tests (we have strict peering windows).
>
> Blockers we need resolved to hit the current schedule:
> 1) Network window: request a two-hour window 8/18 for staged perf tests.
> 2) Access to a schema repo or sample payloads for structured outputs.
"

We'll follow up with the repo links & adapter repo by EOD today.

—Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lindsey Turner <lindsey.turner@caregrid.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthplex.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CareGrid MAP: integration build milestone owners, target close, and blockers

Appreciate the quick confirmations. To summarize and lock the MAP for your procurement + SOW cadence:
- Owners confirmed: SDK client work — CareGrid dev lead (TBD, Lindsey to confirm Priya Singh). Redwood to supply JS/Python adapters (Marissa + Neha).
- Tool-calling: contract defined jointly; CareGrid product owner + Redwood to own the production adapter.
- Network perf window: tentative 2026-08-18 14:00-16:00 ET (Samir to confirm with netops).
- Target close shifted per procurement request: 2026-09-27 (CareGrid requested +1 week).

I'll update the caregrid_map_draft_v1.xlsx with these owner confirmations and the new target close date, then share a refreshed MAP and a short MAP-focused kickoff agenda for 2026-08-12 (30 minutes) — propose 10:00 AM ET.

Action items:
- Lindsey: confirm SDK dev lead (Priya?) and procurement sign-off request by EOD Friday (2026-08-07).
- Samir: confirm perf window and share schema repo link.
- Marissa / Neha: attach adapter repos and checklist (Marissa attached sdk-integration-checklist.pdf).
- Jordan: I'll loop you into the procurement thread for SOW cadence and any credit/terms asks.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the kickoff.

Aditya
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: caregrid_map_draft_v1.xlsx)"
